verdict: ERPNext PROJECTS / SUPPORT OPERATIONAL PROOF READY
description: Onboarding packet E: prove standard ERPNext Project / Task / Timesheet / Issue can run CorpFlowAI's minimum internal delivery and support model. Reuse #920 synthetic records. No custom DocTypes. No second project/helpdesk app. No Postgres mutation. No send. No timesheet submit.

persistence.reason: Map CorpFlowAI delivery/request refs onto existing ERPNext Project/Issue names. Do not add a table or DocType. Do not PATCH live Postgres.

timesheet.reason: Draft non-billable Timesheet path is already proven under #920. Daily owner/status/next-action uses Project + Task + Issue. Named Employee timesheets remain HTTP 403. Billing-bearing submit would require Chart of Accounts and is out of this packet.

sla_assignment_rule.reason: SLA and Assignment Rule remain HTTP 403 to the integration identity and are not required for a one-human plus AI operating model. Manual owner + ToDo + status conventions are enough for initial onboarding.

operating_conventions.project_owner: Use Project.owner as the durable owner on this hosted site. Project.project_manager is not present on the standard Project GET here; Project User child rows did not persist for the integration identity. Named next-person assignment uses ToDo.
operating_conventions.project_status: Open while delivery is live. Completed when the last milestone Task is Completed. Cancelled only if the engagement is abandoned.
operating_conventions.project_next_action: The next action is the first incomplete Task, preferring Working then Overdue then Open, then exp_start_date. Do not add a custom next-action field.
operating_conventions.project_closure: Mark remaining Tasks Completed, then set Project status Completed. Keep GitHub / /change evidence in CorpFlowAI. Do not invent a second project app.
operating_conventions.task_owner: Use standard Task.owner plus a ToDo assignee when a named next person is required. Employee is not required for this operating model.
operating_conventions.task_status: Open = not started. Working = current next action. Overdue = ERPNext date-derived warning. Completed = done. Do not use parent_task unless a real WBS subtree is needed; use depends_on for sequence.
operating_conventions.task_progress: 0 at Open. Raise progress only on Working. 100 only with Completed.
operating_conventions.timesheet: Do not keep daily hours in Timesheets for initial onboarding. If hours are later needed for cost sanity, keep Timesheets draft and non-billable until accounting foundation exists.
operating_conventions.issue_owner: Issue.owner is the document owner. Put the working assignee on a ToDo. Do not enable Assignment Rule yet.
operating_conventions.issue_status: Open = needs action. Replied = internal note recorded, waiting. Closed = done. Reopen to Open. Do not email the client from ERPNext.
operating_conventions.issue_trail: Use Communication with medium Other and sent_or_received Received, or Issue.description. Comment DocType may be 403. Never Communication medium Email.
operating_conventions.issue_closure: Close the ERPNext Issue when the durable support case is finished. Keep /change as the execution surface. Do not replace CMP tickets with a second helpdesk.
operating_conventions.no_portal: Leave via_customer_portal=0. Clients continue to use /change.
